## Streyn 1.14.6

- **Discord:** a Discord button next to your profile picture (title bar on the computer, top of the page on the phone) opens the Streyn Discord server. It appears as soon as the invite link is set, no app update needed for that
- **Docs:** simpler and clearer, in four groups (Get started, Listen, Anywhere, Help), with the Chillscreen, playback settings, other devices, Discord status and the new playlist roles

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
